description: Card 20261115-b-234610: `check`'s live open-agent cap check (`commands::check::fetch_live_open_counts`, backed by `mv_engine::seatstate`) must exclude a busy Nexus pane from a worker seat's own cap -- the same exclusion `commands::dispatch`'s `is_nexus_role` already applies to dispatch/council. A seat capped at 1, hosting only one busy Nexus pane (no worker pane at all), has zero worker panes open and must resolve its scout chain quietly, exiting EXIT_OK (0). Before this fix the Nexus pane counted against the cap, the chain read `ChainExhaustedError`/UNRESOLVED, and `check` exited EXIT_NEEDS_CONFIG (3).
